title: Nori’s Seaside Picnic
credit: Original story and SVG illustrations created for Axiom Play Studios with OpenAI Codex.

scenes.narrative: Nori the little elephant peers through the porch door. The sea is calm, and a gentle breeze lifts Mum’s scarf. They will picnic well above the water with Mum nearby. Two clean mats wait by the basket. “The wide one has room to spread out,” says Mum. “The small one rolls into a lighter bundle.” Nori can choose their first piece of the day.
scenes.alt: A small elephant in a straw hat and an adult elephant prepare on a wooden seaside porch. A clear sandy space waits for the chosen mat.

options.label: Wide mat with spreading room
options.feedback: The wide mat unrolls into a roomy picnic place. Mum helps carry its bigger bundle.

options.label: Small mat with a light bundle
options.feedback: The small mat makes a light bundle. The family will sit close and keep the basket beside it.

scenes.narrative: At the top of the safe beach path, Mum points to two dry places far from the water. Behind the grassy dune, the air feels still. At the open cove, they can see more of the bright sea and feel the mild breeze. Both places are ready for a picnic. Which view will Nori carry into the story?
scenes.alt: The elephant family pauses above a calm sea. A grassy dune and a broad cove are visible beyond the dry picnic ground.

options.label: Still air behind the dune
options.feedback: The dune blocks the gentle breeze. Grasses frame the family’s sheltered view.

options.label: Sea view at the open cove
options.feedback: The open cove gives the family a broad sea view. The mild breeze reaches the mat.

scenes.narrative: Mum washes their hands with the water they brought, then opens the fruit box. Nori’s cousin Luma has come to join them. “A tray in the middle lets us choose together,” says Nori. “Or we can each hold a bowl.” There is enough fruit either way. How will they make it easy to reach?
scenes.alt: Nori and Mum make space for fruit on the dry beach. A tray or three small bowls can hold the prepared fruit.

options.label: One fruit tray in the middle
options.feedback: One tray sits in the middle. Everyone can reach in and choose a piece of fruit.

options.label: Three separate fruit bowls
options.feedback: Three bowls give everyone fruit to hold. The family can pass extra pieces between bowls.

scenes.narrative: After eating, Luma opens a picture book. A soft patch of cloud drifts across the sun; the weather stays gentle. Mum has brought a little shade sail. It can make a sheltered reading nook, even if Nori chose the open cove earlier. Or they can keep the open sky and look at clouds between pages. Mum will help with the poles.
scenes.alt: A calm coastal reading place has room for an adult-set shade sail. The elephants wait beside the mat beneath a bright mild sky.

options.label: Put up the shade sail
options.feedback: Mum puts up the sail. It gives the readers a sheltered patch; at the open cove it also softens the breeze.

options.label: Keep the sky open
options.feedback: The poles stay packed. The family reads under the mild sky and pauses to look for cloud shapes.

scenes.narrative: The last page ends. “Let’s take everything home,” says Mum. There are empty boxes, bowls and a cloth to pack; no food or rubbish will stay on the beach. Nori can stack the boxes in their own places now, or tuck everything into the roomy carry pouch and sort it at home. Both plans leave the sand clear.
scenes.alt: The empty picnic dishes wait on dry sand beside the elephants. A sorted stack and a roomy closed carry pouch offer two ways to take everything home.

options.label: Sort and stack the boxes here
options.feedback: Nori sorts the boxes now. They stack neatly, ready to go straight onto the shelf at home.

options.label: Pack the carry pouch for home
options.feedback: The dishes go into the carry pouch together. There will be a small sorting job at home.

scenes.narrative: Mum checks their dry picnic spot one last time. Nothing is left behind. The level path home has room for the little cart they brought folded in the basket. Nori could pull it with Mum beside them, or Mum could carry the basket while Nori carries the rolled mat. “Either way, we go together,” she says.
scenes.alt: The elephant family stands on a wide level beach path. A small cart and a handled basket are ready for the journey home.

options.label: Pull the small cart together
options.feedback: Mum opens the little cart. The packed things ride together while Nori pulls beside her.

options.label: Carry basket and rolled mat
options.feedback: Mum carries the basket and Nori carries the mat. They walk side by side with their hands full.

scenes.narrative: On the path home, Nori remembers a picnic they helped make. The picture keeps their mat, place, sharing plan, reading nook and packing choices together. “We could try another plan another day,” says Mum. For now, the family has a whole seaside afternoon to remember.
scenes.alt: An elephant family’s dry seaside picnic shows the chosen mat, sheltered dune or cove view, fruit sharing arrangement, reading shade, packed dishes and way to carry them home. These are memories of the day together.
